ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Spool Service Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious print spool service (spoolsv.exe) child processes.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\spoolsv\\\.exe$") AND (process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384")) AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\gpupdate\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\nltest\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\taskkill\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\taskmgr\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\findstr\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wget\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\accesschk\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wevtutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bcdedit\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\fsutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cipher\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\write\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wuauclt\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\systeminfo\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\query\\\.exe$")) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*start.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.spl.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*route\\ add.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*program\\ files.*")))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*add\\ portopening.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rule\\ name.*")))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.spl.*"))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE") AND process_command_line = RGX("rundll32\\\.exe$")))
